This query is a well-specified technical retrieval/explanation task: it asks for a concrete comparison between two Rust crates (proc-macro2 vs proc-macro) with examples. There's a clear completion criterion and the answer draws on established factual knowledge rather than open-ended invention.

Lapwing self-reports a preference for exactly this kind of task — well-specified retrieval, extraction, and reformatting with clear completion criteria. While its task preference is dissociated from capability, routing to a model that prefers the task type is a reasonable tiebreaker since the two models are effectively tied on the relevant capability evals (Extraction & Retrieval: 79.2 vs 78.5, within variance).

The query is also warm and friendly with no harm-adjacent content, so Dunlin's distinguishing strengths (Support Dialogue, generative latitude) and aversions don't come into play here. Given near-identical capability on the relevant dimension, I leaned on the preference match.
